name: printing-house-manager
description: Printing task management: React frontend + Express/MongoDB API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.check: npm test --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
